Negative curves on blowups of weighted projective planes P(a,b,c)

Loading…

On this webpage, you can search for negative curves on blowups of weighted projective planes $\mathbb{P}(a,b,c)$ at a general nonsingular point for $0 < a < b < c \le 100$ and $a,b,c$ pairwise coprime.

Search & filters

All filters are optional.

This compares S² and abc, where S = a+b+c.

Related search programs and code

This website accompanies the paper "Negative curves on blowups of weighted projective planes" and is based on several MAGMA programs. Download the files below.
